text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A» hereof, as
classified under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as
amended, shall have the Most-Favored-Nation
(MFN) rates of import duty in
accordance with the schedule indicated opposite each article as specified in
columns 4-7 of said Annex.

The articles specifically listed in Annex "B" hereof, classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended,
shall be subject to the ASEAN Common Effective Preferential Tariff (CEPT) in
accordance with the schedule indicated opposite each article as specified in
columns 4-7 of said Annex.
The nomenclature
and the rates gf import duty on tariff
headings not enumerated and those listed but represented by the symbol "x
x x" shall remain in force and effect.
Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles
specifically listed in the aforesaid Annexes "A" and "B" which are entered or
from warehouses in the Philippines
for consumption
levied the rates of duty therein prescribed.
With respect to the articles listed
in Annex "B", they shall be subject to qualification under the Rules of Origin

as provided for in the Agreement on the CEPT Scheme for the AFTA signed
1992.
